data_product_overview:
## About this dashboard
Effective financial planning is essential for managing NHS prescribing expenditure. The Budget Report in ePACT2 provides authorised users with a comprehensive view of prescribing costs against allocated budgets at SICBL, ICB, and practice levels. This report enables organisations to monitor monthly and cumulative spend, compare actual costs with forecasted budgets, and identify variances that may require corrective action.

The report includes detailed breakdowns of Net Ingredient Cost (NIC), fees, and adjustments, allowing users to understand the financial impact of prescribing activity. Interactive features enable filtering by time period, organisation, and therapeutic category, supporting granular analysis and informed decision-making.

The aim of the Budget Report is to promote transparency and accountability in financial management. It helps commissioners and providers assess whether prescribing expenditure aligns with planned budgets and identify areas where efficiencies can be achieved without compromising patient care. While the report offers valuable financial insights, it should be used alongside clinical dashboards to ensure that cost control measures support medicines optimisation and quality outcomes. Its intention is to generate discussion within local health economies, inform strategic planning, and support compliance with NHS financial governance.
